newsitem.title: USA: Vinik group lifts Innovex stake to 6.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vinik group lifts Innovex stake to 6.7 pct.

text.p: A group led by former Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Tuesday it raised its stake in Innovex Inc to 6.7 percent or 959,900 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought a net of 193,900 shares of Innovex between December 27 to January 6 at prices ranging from $25.6406 to $29.468 a share.
The group previously held a 5.4 percent stake or 766,000 shares. The stake is held for investment purposes.
Innovex is a Hopkins, Minn.,-based maker of precision electromagnetic products.
